# Sermon Keeper

> AI-powered sermon notes app for iOS. Record sermons, take timestamped notes, and get automatic on-device AI transcription with a summary and key points. Built specifically for churchgoers.

## About

Sermon Keeper is an iOS app for church-going Christians who want to capture, remember, and reflect on sermons. It combines audio recording, timestamped note-taking, Bible verse autocomplete, and on-device AI transcription in one simple app — designed to be used during a live service, even with no internet in the sanctuary.

## Key Features

- One-tap sermon recording in high-quality audio
- Timestamped notes — each note saves the exact moment in the sermon so you can jump back to it
- Bible verse autocomplete — type a reference like John 3:16 and see the full verse
- On-device AI transcription with an organized summary and key points (works offline, keeps data private)
- SOAP study cards — scan a Bible page and get a Scripture / Observation / Application / Prayer journal in about 30 seconds
- iCloud sync — recordings and notes stay on your device and sync to your personal iCloud
- Works in English and Spanish
- No account required — download and start recording immediately

## Pricing

- Free 3-day trial
- $6.99/month or $64.99/year for unlimited recordings and transcriptions

## Who It's For

- Busy church-goers who want to remember the sermon but can't take detailed notes during service
- Bible study groups who want to share accurate sermon notes without retyping everything
- New believers who want to catch every Bible reference the pastor mentions

## Technical Details

- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Bible Version: King James Version (KJV), more translations coming
- Data Storage: On-device + iCloud sync (private; Sermon Keeper has no access to your data)
- Languages: English, Spanish
